what: A tall photo filling its frame: the visible area slowly moves from the top edge (50% 0%) to the bottom edge (50% 100%) from when the frame enters the bottom of the screen until it leaves at the top — with scrub 3 it trails nearly 3 seconds behind even after scrolling stops, and the curve is the GSAP default (power1.out). The frame size stays the same, only the image inside drifts, a subtle parallax

options.scrub: Default 3 (set per cell with the original data-scrub)
options.--fx-ops-size: Background size of a panel that is not img·video (css variable), default 100% 160%

from.where: All pages .js-parallax photo (original ImgParallax — object-position 50% 0% → 50% 100% · start top bottom · end bottom top · scrub 3)
